annotations.description: Deletes an ordo_* admin entity via a real POST - all 7 Delete controllers (Campaign/Segment/AdAudience/WhatsAppTemplate/ContentBlock/ FreeGiftOffer/ScoreRule) implement HttpPostActionInterface since #24's Tier 0 CSRF fix, so Magento's HttpMethodValidator now 404s a plain GET to the delete URL before Delete::execute() ever runs (root-caused via a real CI run: every "has been deleted" .message-success assertion failed identically because the delete itself never happened). Builds and submits a hidden form with the session's form_key - exactly what Magento_Ui/js/grid/columns/actions.js's 'post: true' does for the grid's own Delete link (see AbstractEntityActionsColumn::prepareDataSource) - instead of clicking through the link's confirm() dialog, which this suite has no existing grid-row-action MFTF pattern for.

executeJS.function: var f=document.createElement('form'); f.method='POST'; f.action='/{{url}}'; var i=document.createElement('input'); i.type='hidden'; i.name='form_key'; i.value=window.FORM_KEY; f.appendChild(i); document.body.appendChild(f); f.submit();
